Keeping Park Place blocks that and gives me something to bargain with later. My priorities haven't changed: finish the light blues by getting Vermont, and keep New York away from gpt-6.1-sol (p1), who already has two of the three oranges.

Maybe it's smarter to just hold onto the leverage and end my turn instead.
